overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair's post asking a member to resign was not shown to reflect a quorum's communication outside a meeting, though the AG cautioned against deliberating over social media.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Select Board deliberated outside a posted meeting when the Chair published a post asking a member to resign.
allegations.key_passage: In light of the statements of the Board members, we find that Chair Burrows did not communicate with a quorum of the Board in preparation of the Facebook post.
